sections.content: Agent-native software dominates today's front page: orchestration runtimes, coding-agent skills, harnesses, and interfaces for turning existing software into agent tools occupy most of the top positions.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent orchestration and runtime infrastructure, agent-native software interfaces, coding-agent operations and methodology. Languages: Python 4, TypeScript 3, Go 2, Shell 1.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: Momentum is shifting from model-centric projects toward orchestration, harnesses, skills, CLIs, and agent-compatible work surfaces.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub momentum is concentrated in the infrastructure needed to make agents reliable participants in real software workflows. The key product boundary is the harness, interface, skill system, and domain application around the model.
